concepts.title: Plate and sphere references
concepts.instruction: Draw the 50 mm square plan, central sphere circle of R15 and its elevation tangent to the plate.

concepts.title: View plate
concepts.instruction: Draw the horizontal isometric rhombus at true 50 mm side and its diagonals to locate P.

concepts.title: View sphere centre
concepts.instruction: Raise O vertically by the true 15 mm centre height from P.

concepts.title: View sphere outline
concepts.instruction: With O as centre draw the sphere silhouette with radius sqrt(3/2) × 15 ≈ 18.37 mm, shown as 1.22 R15.

concepts.title: Projection plate and centre
concepts.instruction: Construct the scale; use iso 50 for the plate and iso 15 for the vertical centre height.

concepts.title: Projection sphere outline
concepts.instruction: Draw the projected sphere silhouette with true radius 15 mm, not iso 15.

concepts.title: Complete annotations
concepts.instruction: Add O/P, the plate vertices and both radius and centre-height dimensions.

notes: A sphere projects to a true-radius circle in orthographic isometric projection. In an isometric VIEW (the entire projection enlarged by 1/k), the circle radius is enlarged by 1/k, approximately 1.22.
O–P is the projected centre-to-contact offset; P need not lie on the visible silhouette circle. Do not force visual tangency of that circle to the isometric plate.
